_comment: The constraint file. Every pitch must cite >=2 asset ids. Edit the TODOs before first run - the whole system is only as good as this file.

operator._hours_note: 5-8 realistic on top of carpentry, KalshiML, Helm & Fortune and DoorDash. Treat 8 as a ceiling, not a target.
operator._cash_note: Per-idea test budget. Anything needing more must earn its way there.
operator.risk_tolerance: Not yet specified by the operator. Do not assume high.
hard_nos: Anything that requires an audience he does not already have. Helm & Fortune's existing subscribers count as an audience he HAS; a hypothetical TikTok following does not.
Anything requiring a hire or a partner before first revenue
Anything whose first step is building a platform rather than making a sale

assets.desc: Finish carpentry at professional level; job-site judgment; tool ownership
assets.leverage: Can produce physical goods, evaluate builds, teach, or spec work others can't
Warm distribution to small contractors - a real, hard-to-buy channel

assets.desc: Helm & Fortune - traditional Hellenistic astrology practice; natal readings, horary, lunation/daily subscription tiers
assets.leverage: Existing audience, existing paying subscribers, existing content pipeline

assets.desc: Multi-skill automated reading pipeline (engine -> portraits -> verdict blocks -> prose -> PDF)
assets.leverage: Marginal cost per report near zero; capacity is not the bottleneck

assets.desc: KalshiML - live prediction-market ML system, evidence/gating engine, calibration, execution layer
assets.leverage: Working forecasting + calibration machinery, transferable beyond weather markets

assets.desc: SplitRail - multi-tenant Stripe Connect batch payouts for contractors paying 1099 workers
assets.leverage: Payment rails already built; a second product could ride them

assets.desc: Railway/GitHub bridge with agent_loop, tool layer, allowlisted fetch, watchdog, Resend email
assets.leverage: Can build and ship small services fast and unattended

assets.desc: Ship and operate production services on Railway/GitHub solo
Mechanically inclined; strong used-car evaluation knowledge
assets.leverage: Arbitrage/appraisal/content angles in a market with real money and bad information

existing_revenue.desc: KalshiML - paper mode, not yet trading real size

explicitly_in_scope: Creator/influencer businesses (own or as an operator for others)
